meta.source: Extracted from cs2skin.com computed styles and CSS custom properties (2026-11-12), extended with game-specific tokens.

tokens.name: bg-950
tokens.usage: Page background and input wells (site --Gray950 / --background). The ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: bg-930
tokens.usage: Panels, chat sidebar, modifier chips, unselected segmented options (site --Gray930, the most-used surface).

tokens.name: bg-900
tokens.usage: Cards, bet panel body, dropdown triggers, road asphalt (site --Gray900).

tokens.name: bg-850
tokens.usage: Hover state of bg-900 surfaces; alternate road lane (site --Gray850).

tokens.name: bg-800
tokens.usage: Raised surface, dividers, sidewalk strip, empty board tile (site --Gray800).

tokens.name: bg-700
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected neutral surfaces (site --BgGray700).

tokens.name: glass-10
tokens.usage: Disabled / idle CTA fill (site's 'Start Game' when logged out). White text on it over bg-900 passes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and the round-result banner.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: Headings, multipliers, text on primary-500 and blood-600 fills.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Default body text on any bg-* surface (site --foreground).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inactive tabs, ghost-button labels, icons. 8.4:1 on bg-950 (site --Gray300).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, timestamps, helper copy. 5.2:1 on bg-900 (site --Gray400 subtitle).

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: Field labels ('Bet Amount') as on the site. FAILS 4.5:1 (3.4:1 on bg-900) — kept from source; only at 14px/600 or larger, prefer text-subtle for new UI.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only; never for information (2.4:1).

tokens.name: text-on-bright
tokens.usage: Text on grass-400, sun-500 and lake-500 fills (white fails on those).

tokens.name: primary-300
tokens.usage: Violet text and icons on dark surfaces; links.

tokens.name: primary-400
tokens.usage: Hover of primary-500 fills; violet text that must pass 4.5:1 (4.8:1 on bg-950).

tokens.name: primary-500
tokens.usage: Brand violet: main CTA ('Place Bet', 'Go'), active selection border, current lane. Text on it: text-title (5.7:1). As text it fails small sizes (3.4:1) — use primary-300/400.

tokens.name: primary-600
tokens.usage: Pressed primary-500.

tokens.name: primary-700
tokens.usage: Violet tint fill for selected chips and the passed-lane trail.

tokens.name: primary-800
tokens.usage: Deep violet panel tint, header glow.

tokens.name: primary-900
tokens.usage: Darkest violet; base of violet radial glows.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Violet-tinted card fill (ticker items, active tile). Text-body on it passes.

tokens.name: grass-300
tokens.usage: Win highlights, +profit text.

tokens.name: grass-400
tokens.usage: Cash Out button, safe lane, win state. Text on it: text-on-bright (10:1).

tokens.name: grass-500
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed Cash Out.

tokens.name: grass-600
tokens.usage: Win border on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: grass-800
tokens.usage: Win banner background, start/finish grass verge.

tokens.name: blood-400
tokens.usage: Loss text and -profit numbers (6.5:1 on bg-950).

tokens.name: blood-500
tokens.usage: Crash flash, hit car, error icon. White text only at 24px+ (3.8:1).

tokens.name: blood-600
tokens.usage: Crash banner fill with text-title (5.6:1).

tokens.name: blood-800
tokens.usage: Crashed lane tint, error border.

tokens.name: blood-900
tokens.usage: Loss banner background.

tokens.name: sun-300
tokens.usage: Coin highlight, jackpot shimmer stop.

tokens.name: sun-500
tokens.usage: Coin / currency icon, multiplier chips on upcoming lanes, road dashes. Text on it: text-on-bright.

tokens.name: sun-700
tokens.usage: Coin shadow and rim.

tokens.name: sun-900
tokens.usage: Gold badge background (site --Background-Color-BgBadgeSun900).

tokens.name: lake-500
tokens.usage: Info accent, 'auto bet running' state.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Support / staff tags, links in chat.

tokens.name: pink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary accent (site --Secondary500); promos only.

tokens.name: car-blue
tokens.usage: Car body. The seven car colours are the site's game-tile accents; pick at random per car.

tokens.name: car-orange
tokens.usage: Car body.

tokens.name: car-red
tokens.usage: Car body. Never on the lane the chicken is about to enter (reads as crash).

tokens.name: car-green
tokens.usage: Car body.

tokens.name: car-gold
tokens.usage: Car body.

tokens.name: car-magenta
tokens.usage: Car body.

tokens.name: car-violet
tokens.usage: Car body; also the 'boss' truck on Hardcore.

tokens.name: road-asphalt
tokens.usage: Asphalt base under the road texture (raw_assets/images/asphalt.jpg averages to it). One grey for every lane.

tokens.name: road-dash
tokens.usage: Road markings, white paint as on a real road: dashed lines between lanes, solid lines along both edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: road-curb
tokens.usage: Concrete kerb between the grass verges and the road.

tokens.name: manhole
tokens.usage: Manhole cover fill — the tap target in each unopened lane, multiplier printed on it.

tokens.name: manhole-groove
tokens.usage: Grille grooves on the manhole cover.

tokens.name: manhole-rim
tokens.usage: Manhole rim; becomes primary-400 on the next tappable lane.

tokens.name: barrier
tokens.usage: Roadblock that drops into a lane once it's cleared; stops cars visually.

tokens.name: chicken-body
tokens.usage: Chicken sprite base colour.

tokens.name: chicken-comb
tokens.usage: Comb and wattle.

tokens.name: chicken-beak
tokens.usage: Beak and feet.

styles.name: multiplier-xl
styles.usage: Live multiplier over the board and in the result banner. tabular-nums.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels. Title Case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Modifier chips, lane multipliers, ticker sublines.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Level badges, tags. Never for amounts.

tokens.name: space-50
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon-to-badge.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Chip internal gap.

tokens.name: space-150
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding, chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-200
tokens.usage: Ticker card padding, gap between lanes, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-300
tokens.usage: Button padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-400
tokens.usage: Bet panel padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-600
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside the panel.

tokens.name: space-800
tokens.usage: Gap between panel and board.

tokens.name: space-1200
tokens.usage: Page section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-1600
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-2400
tokens.usage: Large layout offsets.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small dropdown triggers, tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Modifier chips (site: 5px), toasts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented options, ticker cards, lane multiplier tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Game tiles, bet panel, board frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, result banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and the multiplier chip — the site's buttons are all pills.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Primary pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating cards and modals (site's layered shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Input focus halo, as on the site; pair with a solid primary-500 border.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom bevel on tiles and the header.

tokens.name: glow-primary
tokens.usage: Current lane, hovered Go button. Game addition.

tokens.name: glow-win
tokens.usage: Cash Out button while live; win banner. Game addition.

tokens.name: glow-crash
tokens.usage: Crash flash on the hit lane. Game addition.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Top bar (site --header-height).

tokens.name: chat-width
tokens.usage: Host-site chat sidebar on desktop (≥1280px). Collapsible to 0; hidden under 1024px.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom nav (site --bottom-nav-height).

tokens.name: bet-panel-width
tokens.usage: Desktop bet panel column (site Mines panel).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs, tabs and the main CTA.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Header buttons.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Modifier chips inside inputs.

tokens.name: segment-height
tokens.usage: Difficulty options.

tokens.name: lane-width
tokens.usage: One road lane on desktop; 80px under 768px.
